title: Piling Operations Risk Assessment
description: Free Piling Operations Risk Assessment template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers 29 cfr 1926 subpart q - concrete, piling, piling project information, pre-piling engineering and site preparation.

EQUIPMENT OVERTURN PROCEDURES:

1. Call 911 immediately - advise "heavy equipment tip-over with possible injuries"

2. DO NOT attempt to rescue trapped workers without proper equipment

3. Account for all personnel - determine who may be trapped

4. Secure area - prevent unauthorized access

5. Shut off engine/fuel if safe to do so

6. Wait for emergency responders with heavy rescue capability

7. Provide equipment specifications to responders

STRUCTURAL DAMAGE PROCEDURES:

1. Stop piling operations immediately

2. Evacuate affected building/area if necessary

3. Notify engineer and project management

4. Assess damage - document with photos

5. Implement remedial measures as directed by engineer

6. Resume only after approval

FIRE PROCEDURES:

1. Sound alarm - call 911

2. If safe, use fire extinguisher (ABC dry chemical for diesel/hydraulic)

3. Evacuate area - account for personnel

4. Shut off engine/fuel source if safe

5. Do not use water on fuel fires

Piling Operations Risk Assessment Summary

OVERALL RISK ASSESSMENT:

Based on the identified hazards and existing controls, the overall risk level for this piling operation:

☐ LOW - Favorable ground conditions, isolated area, minimal vibration concerns

☐ MEDIUM - Moderate risks, requires ongoing monitoring

☐ HIGH - Significant risks (sensitive structures, difficult ground), requires strict controls

☐ EXTREME - Severe risks - requires engineering controls and specialized oversight

WORK STOPPING AUTHORITY:

All personnel have the authority and responsibility to stop work if conditions become unsafe.
